name: robots/mindspaceinc__spot-mujoco-ros2
title: MindSpaceInc Spot Mini MuJoCo ROS 2 simulator
intro: MindSpaceInc Spot Mini MuJoCo ROS 2 simulator, adapted from mindspaceinc/spot-mujoco-ros2. It reads `joint_positions` and `read_joint_states`; runs `publish_actuator_cmds`, `reset_simulation` and `reset_safe_state`. `publish_actuator_cmds`: publish one communication/msg/ActuatorCmds message on /simulation/actuators_cmds with the 12 actuator names fixed in MJCF order. The node applies the PD expression and clamps each resulting ctrl to [-100, 100]; a publication receipt is transmission only, not motion. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
